defs.def: to keep sb/sth safe from death, harm, loss, etc. 救；救助；挽救；拯救

ex.s: In my ninth-grade writing class last year, I met a cowboy who saved his town, a strict father who demanded his son earn straight A’s, and a modern-day Juliet who died of heartbreak after her parents rejected the love of her young life.
ex.t: 在去年九年级的写作班上,我遇到了一位拯救了小镇的牛仔,一位严格要求儿子挣得A的父王,以及一位现代朱丽叶,她的父母拒绝了她年轻时的爱情后,因心碎去世.

ex.s: We were ___22___it would not be enough to save him.
As time goes on, I remain____33____by the experience of witnessing a nine-year-old save a stranger's life.
ex.t: 随着时间的流逝,我还是... ...通过亲眼目睹一个九岁的孩子 拯救一个陌生人的生命的经验

ex.s: "He saved my   64   （son）life," said Mrs Brown.

ex.s: A rescue worker risked his life saving two tourists who _________ in the mountains for two days.
ex.t: 一名救援人员冒着生命危险,拯救了两名游客,他们在山区逗留了两天。

ex.s: If you want time to have breakfast with your family, save some time the night before by setting out clothes, shoes, and bags.
ex.t: 如果你想和家人一起吃早饭,请在前一天晚上把衣服、鞋子和袋子放好。

ex.s: But the World Bank has included the project on its of "100 ideas to save the planet＂.

ex.s: My team saved my life.”

ex.t: 我在伦敦度过了美好的一天 也帮助拯救大猩猩!

ex.s: By the time she was 13，her company was worth millions of dollars with the invention of a super-sweet treat that could save kids' teeth，instead of destroying them.
ex.t: 在她13岁时, 她的公司价值数百万美元 发明了一个超甜的治疗 能够拯救孩子们的牙齿,而不是摧毁他们。

ex.s: In Save Money: Good Food, she visits a different home each week and with the help of chef Matt Tebbutt offers top tips on how to reduce food waste, while preparing recipes for under £5 per family a day.
ex.t: 在"拯救金钱:好食物"(Save Money: Good Food)中,她每星期都会到不同的家参观,并在主厨马特·特布特的帮助下,就如何减少食物浪费提供最高提示,同时为每个家庭每天不足5英镑的食谱准备.

ex.s: But using cheese brine could help both cheese producers and cities save money, while keeping roads safe Cheese brine has salt in it, which, like the rock salt, helps lower water’s freezing point.
ex.t: 但使用奶酪浴缸可以帮助奶酪生产者和城市省钱,同时保持道路安全 奶酪浴缸里还有盐,这与岩石盐一样,有助于降低水的冻结点。

defs.def: to keep money instead of spending it, especially in order to buy a particular thing 储蓄；攒钱

ex.s: He wanted to save money for pet owners.
ex.t: 他想为宠物主人省钱

ex.s: You’ll compete with fewer tourists, save money, experience a different side of a popular place, and boost the economy when tourism is traditionally slower.
ex.t: 与较少游客竞争, 省钱,

ex.s: To save money for her parents.
ex.t: 为她父母存钱.

ex.s: In addition to saving money, cheese brine could also be a more eco-friendly option.
ex.t: 除了省钱外,奶酪浴缸还可以是一种更有利于生态的选择.

ex.s: This is a programme run by The Gorilla Organization to raise money to save the world’s last remaining gorillas from dying out.
ex.t: 由大猩猩组织管理,

defs.def: to collect sth because you like it or for a special purpose 收集；收藏
to keep sth to use or enjoy in the future 保留；保存

ex.t: 图像保存为 PDF 文件

defs.def: to avoid wasting sth or using more than necessary 节省；节约

ex.s: For those wishing to park near friends, all vehicles must have passes for the same zone and arrive together — spaces cannot be saved.
ex.t: 对于想在朋友附近停车的人来说,所有车辆都必须有进入同一区的通行证并一起到达——空间是无法节省的。

ex.s: Good habits save time, energy and sometimes your life.
ex.t: 好习惯可以节省时间,精力,有时可以节省生命.

ex.s: You would think learning takes more time from you, but actually there are always new ways of doing things that can save you time on daily tasks, freeing you up for the most important.
ex.t: 你会认为学习需要你更多的时间, 但实际上总有新的方法来做一些事情, 可以节省你每天的工作时间, 让你为最重要的事情腾出时间。

ex.s: Glowing plants could reduce this distance and therefore help save energy.
ex.t: 光辉的植物可以缩短这种距离,从而帮助节省能量.

ex.s: B． It saves time and effort in cooking．
ex.t: B. 节省烹饪时间和精力。

ex.s: It helps them save time.
ex.t: 这有助于他们节省时间。

ex.s: Most of us are aware that we must take care of the environment, and the majority of us take steps to save energy and reduce waste and pollution.
ex.t: 我们大多数人意识到,我们必须保护环境,我们大多数人采取步骤节省能源和减少浪费和污染。

ex.s: In order to save food, we propose: 1 Do not order more than you need in the school canteen.
ex.t: 为了节省食物,我们提议: 1 学校食堂里不要多点菜.

ex.s: It urges people to save food by not wasting anything on the dining table.
ex.t: 它敦促人们不要浪费餐桌上的东西来节省食物.

ex.s: You can plant a tree，make a meal with locally grown vegetables，or save power—the possibilities are endless.
ex.t: 你可以种植一棵树,用当地种植的蔬菜做饭,或者节省电力,但可能性是无限的。

defs.def: to avoid doing sth difficult or unpleasant; to make sb able to avoid doing sth difficult or unpleasant 避免，免得（出现困难或不愉快的事）
to prevent an opponent's shot from going in the goal 足球等

ex.s: Apart from the thrill of those first heart-stopping dives, which, ironically, saved me from going under, what has drawn me is this community of generous, open-hearted souls.
ex.t: 除了那些第一次心脏停止跳水的刺激外, 讽刺的是,它让我免于下沉, 吸引我的是这个慷慨、开放的灵魂社区。

defs.def: to make a computer keep work, for example by putting it on a disk 保存；存盘

ex.s: We all need to get involved in saving energy                  it's at work, at home, or at school.
ex.t: 我们都需要参与节能 工作、家庭或学校
